reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the change replaces two expressions in the single definition.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, which every planning path calls.

scope.why: Only the rule and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Math.min and 'amount minus tolerance' express 'lowest value allowed' directly and are easier to read than the previous sign-based code.
